papers.title: Microbial bioherbicides: Integrating bioprocessing, mechanisms of action and protein engineering for sustainable weed management.
papers.abstract: The widespread use of synthetic herbicides in agriculture has intensified concerns regarding environmental sustainability and human health, while the evolution of herbicide resistance has outpaced the discovery of new modes of action. Bioherbicides have consequently emerged as a viable alternative, comprising biologically derived compounds capable of suppressing weed growth. This review adopts an integrated perspective on microbially derived bioherbicides, following the active biomolecules from the producing strain and its fermentation conditions to their physiological targets in the plant and to the molecular strategies available for their optimization. Unlike previous reviews, which address these dimensions separately and focus mainly on secondary metabolites, particular emphasis is placed here on enzymes with herbicidal activity and on protein engineering approaches. Based on a structured literature search, 39 original studies were analyzed. Phytopathogenic fungi, mainly Fusarium, Diaporthe, Phoma, Alternaria and Trichoderma, predominate as producing organisms, followed by bacteria of the genera Streptomyces, Pseudomonas and Bacillus, and submerged fermentation using low-cost agro-industrial substrates is the prevailing production strategy. Enzymatic classes such as cutinases, lipases, cellulases, pectinases and proteases act primarily by degrading the cuticle and the cell wall, whereas secondary metabolites frequently target the photosynthetic apparatus, particularly photosystem II; most of these compounds, however, still lack a defined mode of action within established herbicide classification systems. Molecular approaches, including heterologous expression, molecular docking and metabolic engineering, remain comparatively underexplored despite their potential to enhance activity, stability and specificity. Advances in formulation stability, bioprocess scalability, mechanistic characterization and regulatory harmonization are identified as the key requirements to translate these biomolecules into commercially viable products for sustainable weed management.
papers.authors: Krein DDC, Conterato AAM, Plucinski R, Dotto GL, Dettmer A.

papers.title: Mirror Biology and Cyberbiosecurity: New Frontiers, Risks, and Strategic Responses
papers.abstract: Mirror biology is the creation of synthetic organisms composed entirely of mirror-image biomolecules, such as D-amino acids and L-sugars, in contrast to the natural use of L-amino acids and D-sugars. Though this novel field promises significant advances in medicine, biomanufacturing, and environmental applications due to the enhanced stability and immune evasion of mirror organisms, its features raise unprecedented biosecurity risks, particularly when combined with cybersecurity vulnerabilities in the digital infrastructures used to design, synthesise, and control mirror life. We mapped the mirror biology development pipeline, from genetic circuit design and cloud-based bioinformatics to automated laboratory systems, to examine the unprecedented biosecurity risks associated with mirror biology. We highlighted key cyber biosecurity vulnerabilities, including data manipulation, unauthorised access, and firmware tampering. Case studies illustrate specific risks such as tampering with genetic design tools and introducing harmful DNA sequences into supply chains. The paper reviews existing technological safeguards, including encryption, zero-trust architectures, AI-enabled anomaly detection, and governance mechanisms such as biosafety oversight and redline enforcement. It emphasises the need for inclusive governance, capacity building, and international collaboration to ensure that mirror biology is not pursued as a field of organism- level research.
papers.authors: Kato SE, Baluku E, Tawiah RN, Serwaa C, Anguzu S, Mang’anda H, Potter L, Ndudzo A, Twizerimana J, Palmer X, Shamirah K.

papers.title: Natural and engineered bacteriophages against multidrug-resistant ESKAPE pathogens: current landscape and clinical translation.
papers.abstract: The worldwide emergence of antimicrobial resistance and the need for non-conventional alternatives to conventional antibiotics have been increased by multidrug-resistant ESKAPE pathogens, which cause the majority of nosocomial infections and are starting to develop resistance to even the most potent drugs. Engineered bacteriophages are promising precision antimicrobials because of their ability to selectively infect and lyse bacterial hosts, multiply at infection sites, and co-evolve with bacterial populations to overcome resistance. Advances in synthetic biology, such as tail fiber modification, depolymerase and endolysin enhancement, genome editing using the clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR), and computationally designed phage cocktails, have opened new possibilities for therapeutics that were hindered by the limitations of natural phages. These engineering strategies expand host range, enhance biofilm penetration, and target resistance genes. In spite of promising evidence in preclinical models, the use of engineered phages in routine clinical practice remains difficult. Specific key challenges include unclear regulations, lack of good manufacturing practice (GMP)grade production, variable pharmacokinetics and limited clinical trial data. This review critically examines engineering approaches to improve phage activity against ESKAPE pathogens, identifies the scientific and regulatory barriers limiting clinical use, and outlines the key steps needed for wider adoption.
papers.authors: Nautiyal D, Sahu M, Jain U.

papers.title: Yeast Surface Display of Artificial Multienzyme Complexes for Enhanced Production of Rebaudioside M.
papers.abstract: Rebaudioside M (Reb M) is an ideal low-calorie natural sweetener with excellent sensory properties and well-established safety profile. Industrial production of Reb M is limited by low natural abundance and the bottlenecks of existing biomanufacturing strategies, including low productivity, intermediate accumulation and high enzyme costs. Here, a novel biosynthetic platform based on yeast surface display of artificial multienzyme complexes was established for efficient Reb M production. The artificial protein scaffold containing multiple orthogonal cohesin modules was displayed on the surface of Pichia pastoris via the AGA1 anchoring motif. Through orthogonal cohesin-dockerin interactions, Reb M biosynthetic pathway enzymes (PgUGT Mut , AtSUS1 and UGT76G1 Mut ) with the corresponding dockerin modules were assembled on the artificial protein scaffold to form multienzyme complexes. The catalytic activity of crude glycosyltransferases was improved by isozyme screening and expression optimization with molecular chaperones. This surface-displayed system demonstrated multiple advantages. First, the multienzyme complex assembled on the yeast surface showed higher catalytic efficiency than free enzymes. Additionally, fructose was consumed by P. pastoris to drive the reaction toward Reb M biosynthesis. Furthermore, the whole-cell catalyst showed promising reusability. Ultimately, this platform enabled the production of 36.88 g/L Reb M with a yield of 91.9% from rebaudioside A (Reb A) in a 10 mL reaction system. This work provided a feasible strategy to address the key bottlenecks in Reb M biomanufacturing and offered a reference for producing other high-value natural products via multi-enzyme cascade catalysis.
papers.authors: Bao J, Qiao C, Li M, Gao J, Gao D, Ye C, Jiang X, Lian J.

papers.title: Artificial Cells and Biomimetic Cells: Intelligent Systems Driving a Paradigm Shift in Drug Discovery and Delivery.
papers.abstract: The convergence of synthetic biology, materials science, and artificial intelligence drives a transformative shift in biopharmaceutical research, advancing from passive drug carriers to intelligent, programmable therapeutics. This review evaluates artificial and biomimetic cells as a framework that connects fundamental biological discovery with clinical translation. It examines five key technological pathways: membrane-engineered artificial cells, membraneless organelle (MLO) systems, multicompartmental artificial cells, protocell communication networks, and virtual cells. These platforms enable precise regulation of drug stability, targeting, biosynthesis, and adaptive responsiveness. Recent progress includes microenvironment-triggered release, logic-gated intercellular communication, and virtual cell-assisted high-throughput screening and toxicity prediction. Despite these advances, challenges remain in scalable manufacturing, long-term stability, and regulatory adaptation. The integration of closed-loop learning, interpretable models, and advanced biomanufacturing will be essential to position artificial and biomimetic cell systems at the forefront of next-generation precision medicine.
papers.authors: Xiang M, Su B, Jiang C, Sun T.

enrichment.titleZh: 人工细胞与仿生细胞：推动药物发现和递送范式转变的智能系统
enrichment.abstractZh: 合成生物学、材料科学与人工智能的融合正推动生物制药研究发生变革，使其从被动药物载体发展为智能、可编程的治疗系统。本综述将人工细胞与仿生细胞作为连接基础生物学发现和临床转化的框架进行评估，并考察了5条关键技术路径：膜工程化人工细胞、无膜细胞器（MLO）系统、多区室人工细胞、原始细胞通讯网络及虚拟细胞。这些平台能够精确调控药物稳定性、靶向性、生物合成及适应性响应能力。近期进展包括微环境触发释放、逻辑门控的细胞间通讯，以及虚拟细胞辅助的高通量筛选和毒性预测。尽管取得这些进展，可规模化制造、长期稳定性及监管适配仍面临挑战。将闭环学习、可解释模型与先进生物制造相整合，将是推动人工细胞与仿生细胞系统走向下一代精准医学前沿的关键。

papers.title: Development of a CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing system for the extremely thermophilic bacterium Anaerocellum bescii
papers.abstract: Anaerocellum (f. Caldicellulosiruptor ) bescii is an extremely thermophilic (T opt 75-78 ℃) anaerobic bacterium and is also a highly efficient degrader of lignocellulose, making it a promising platform for metabolic engineering. To date, chromosomal genetic manipulations in A. bescii have required multistep procedures involving homologous recombination with integrating vectors and counterselection. Here, we demonstrate the first implementation of CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing in A. bescii facilitated by a thermostable Cas9 enzyme from Geobacillus stearothermophilus (GeoCas9). Delivery of heterologous CRISPR machinery via a replicating vector enabled us to individually and sequentially delete genes for lactate dehydrogenase ( ldh ) and pyrE in A. bescii . We then deployed this system to delete a novel target, tryptophan synthase ( trpBA ), generating a tryptophan auxotrophic strain of A. bescii . Using this strain, we show trpBA complementation enables selection and maintenance of a replicating vector expressing a heterologous enzymatic reporter gene. Importance Extreme thermophiles, especially species that can naturally break down recalcitrant lignocellulose, such as Anaerocellum (f. Caldicellulosiruptor ) bescii , represent compelling chassis for next-generation bioprocessing, offering the capability to convert inexpensive and plentiful renewable feedstocks into fuels and industrial chemicals. However, engineering these non-model organisms for bioprocessing applications requires robust genetic engineering tools, as techniques developed in mesophilic model organisms often translate poorly. CRISPR-Cas genome editing, now widely used in biotechnology, is one such tool that faces limitations at the extreme native temperatures of these organisms. Here we establish a CRISPR-Cas9-based genome editing system in A. bescii , expanding the genetic toolbox available for this extremely thermophilic bacterium. By streamlining targeted genetic modifications, this approach has the potential to accelerate the construction of engineered strains for metabolic engineering and bioprocess applications.
papers.authors: Galindo JL, Conway JM.

enrichment.titleZh: 极端嗜热细菌Anaerocellum bescii的CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑系统开发
enrichment.abstractZh:
Anaerocellum bescii（原称Caldicellulosiruptor bescii）是一种极端嗜热的厌氧细菌，最适温度（Topt）为75—78 °C；它还能够高效降解木质纤维素，因此有望成为代谢工程平台。迄今为止，A. bescii的染色体遗传操作需要通过整合型载体介导的同源重组和反向筛选等多步骤程序完成。本研究借助来自Geobacillus stearothermophilus的热稳定Cas9酶（GeoCas9），首次在A. bescii中实现了CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑。通过可复制载体递送异源CRISPR系统，研究者能够在A. bescii中分别及依次删除乳酸脱氢酶基因（ldh）和pyrE。随后，研究者利用该系统删除一个新的靶标——色氨酸合酶基因（trpBA），获得了A. bescii的色氨酸营养缺陷型菌株。利用这一菌株，研究者表明，trpBA互补可支持对表达异源酶类报告基因的可复制载体进行筛选和维持。

研究意义（Importance）：极端嗜热微生物，尤其是Anaerocellum bescii（原称Caldicellulosiruptor bescii）这类能够天然分解难降解木质纤维素的物种，是颇具吸引力的下一代生物加工底盘，具备将廉价且丰富的可再生原料转化为燃料和工业化学品的能力。然而，要为生物加工应用改造这些非模式生物，需要可靠的遗传工程工具，因为针对中温模式生物开发的技术往往难以直接迁移应用。CRISPR-Cas基因组编辑如今已广泛用于生物技术，但它也是在这些生物天然生长的极端温度下受到限制的工具之一。本研究在A. bescii中建立了基于CRISPR-Cas9的基因组编辑系统，扩充了这种极端嗜热细菌可用的遗传工具箱。通过简化靶向遗传改造，该方法有潜力加快构建用于代谢工程和生物加工应用的工程菌株。

papers.title: Metabolic engineering of Escherichia coli to enhance L-serine biosynthesis
papers.abstract: Abstract L-serine, an important non-essential amino acid, is widely used in the food, pharmaceutical, feed, and cosmetic industries. However, previous studies on fermentative L-serine production by Escherichia coli have mainly focused on improving titer, whereas insufficient attention has been paid to the conversion yield, limiting its industrial economic feasibility. In this study, systematic metabolic engineering was performed to improve L-serine yield. Using H5 as the parental strain, the L-serine re-uptake-related genes sstT and tdcC were deleted based on the CRISPR/Cas9 system to generate strain H8, in which the L-serine titer increased to 5.58 g/L and the conversion yield reached 0.37 g/g. Subsequently, the L-serine biosynthetic module, L-serine transport module, and cofactor supply module were individually enhanced in H8, resulting in recombinant strains H8- abc , H8- be , and H8- pntab , respectively. enrichment.titleZh: 通过大肠杆菌代谢工程增强L-丝氨酸生物合成
enrichment.abstractZh: 摘要：L-丝氨酸是一种重要的非必需氨基酸，广泛应用于食品、制药、饲料和化妆品行业。然而，以往关于大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）发酵生产L-丝氨酸的研究主要着眼于提高滴度，对转化得率关注不足，限制了其工业生产的经济可行性。本研究开展系统性代谢工程改造，以提高L-丝氨酸得率。以H5为亲本菌株，利用CRISPR/Cas9系统删除与L-丝氨酸再摄取相关的基因sstT和tdcC，获得菌株H8，其L-丝氨酸滴度提高至5.58 g/L，转化得率达到0.37 g/g。随后，分别增强H8中的L-丝氨酸生物合成模块、L-丝氨酸转运模块和辅因子供应模块，获得重组菌株H8-abc、H8-be和H8-pntab。这3株菌的L-丝氨酸滴度分别为6.40、5.89和5.59 g/L，相应得率分别为0.43、0.39和0.37 g/g。进一步将有效策略组合到H8底盘中，获得菌株H8-abc-be，但其L-丝氨酸产量下降。最后，研究者选择H8-abc进行发酵培养基优化。优化后，摇瓶发酵的L-丝氨酸滴度达到7.20 g/L，得率为0.48 g/g，相比起始菌株H5提高71.84%。这些结果为开发用于工业化生产L-丝氨酸的高效大肠杆菌菌株提供了有用参考。
enrichment.sourceTitle: Metabolic engineering of Escherichia coli to enhance L-serine biosynthesis
enrichment.sourceAbstract: Abstract L-serine, an important non-essential amino acid, is widely used in the food, pharmaceutical, feed, and cosmetic industries. Subsequently, the L-serine biosynthetic module, L-serine transport module, and cofactor supply module were individually enhanced in H8, resulting in recombinant strains H8- abc , H8- be , and H8- pntab , respectively. Finally, H8- abc was selected for fermentation medium optimization. papers.title: Molecular Biology and Synthetic Biology-Guided Development of Recognition and Reporting Elements of Biosensor.
papers.abstract: Microbial cell biosensors are capable of detecting fluctuations in the concentrations of substances both inside and outside the cell, as well as changes in the external environment, and can generate measurable signal outputs. Microbial cell biosensors are characterized by low cost, simple operation, and high specificity. The rapid advancement of synthetic biology has significantly propelled the development and practical application of microbial cell biosensors. In this chapter, we provide a comprehensive summary of the composition and working principles of microbial cell biosensors. Additionally, we introduce various strategies and the latest progress in modifying biorecognition element and reporting elements using molecular biology and synthetic biology techniques in recent years. This book chapter offers new insights and valuable references for the research and development of microbial cell biosensors.
papers.authors: Luo Y, Meng C, Wang L, Liang B.

enrichment.titleZh: 分子生物学与合成生物学指导的生物传感器识别元件和报告元件开发
enrichment.abstractZh: 微生物细胞生物传感器能够检测细胞内外物质浓度的波动以及外部环境变化，并产生可测量的信号输出。这类传感器具有成本低、操作简单和特异性高等特点。合成生物学的快速发展显著推动了微生物细胞生物传感器的开发和实际应用。本章全面总结微生物细胞生物传感器的组成及工作原理，并介绍近年来利用分子生物学和合成生物学技术改造生物识别元件与报告元件的多种策略及最新进展，为微生物细胞生物传感器的研究与开发提供新的认识和参考。

papers.title: Organoids and organs-on-a-chip as new approach methodologies at the convergence of cell biology and bioengineering.
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including organoids and organs-on-a-chip (OOCs), has revealed a need for interdisciplinary dialogue between cell biologists and bioengineers to develop human models that can best complement therapeutic development. Stem cell-derived and bioengineered human tissue models are redefining how we understand human physiology and pathophysiology, offering control that traditional preclinical models cannot provide. By recapitulating complex tissue microenvironments, multi-organ interactions, and patient-specific biology, these systems are bridging long-standing gaps in the drug development and clinical application pipelines. Here, we synthesize advances in organoids, OOCs, and other bioengineered technologies for translational medicine to identify remaining gaps, including challenges in reproducibility, validation, and regulatory acceptance. Emerging opportunities at the intersection of synthetic biology, multi-omics, machine learning, and genetic engineering are positioning NAMs not merely as improved experimental tools but as foundational platforms for accelerating therapeutic discovery and enabling personalized medicine at scale.
papers.authors: Tavakol DN, Mendonca D, Baldassarri I, Maletic-Savatic M, Vunjak-Novakovic G.

enrichment.titleZh: 细胞生物学与生物工程交汇处的新方法学：类器官与器官芯片
enrichment.abstractZh: 包括类器官和器官芯片（OOC）在内的新方法学（NAM）的快速发展，凸显了细胞生物学家与生物工程师开展跨学科对话的必要性，以开发最能辅助治疗手段研发的人源模型。干细胞来源及生物工程构建的人体组织模型正在重塑人们对人体生理与病理生理的理解，并提供传统临床前模型所不能实现的可控性。通过再现复杂组织微环境、多器官相互作用及患者个体特异性的生物学特征，这些系统正在弥合药物研发与临床应用流程中长期存在的缺口。本文综合梳理了类器官、器官芯片及其他用于转化医学的生物工程技术的进展，以识别仍然存在的不足，包括可重复性、验证及监管认可方面的挑战。合成生物学、多组学、机器学习与基因工程交叉领域涌现的机遇，正推动新方法学不仅成为改进的实验工具，也成为加快治疗手段发现、支持规模化个体化医疗的基础平台。

papers.title: Repeated xylitol production by immobilized Gluconobacter oxydans using diatom frustule-alginate composite carriers.
papers.abstract: Xylitol, a common sugar substitute in food and pharmaceuticals, can be produced microbially using glucose as the primary substrate. Our earlier study established an efficient one-step biotransformation system in Gluconobacter oxydans that converts D-arabitol to xylitol. To improve the reusability of resting cells, recombinant G. oxydans was immobilized in a composite matrix of Cyclotella meneghiniana frustules and solium alginate. The combined approach not only enhanced the mechanical strength and stability of the beads but may also have facilitated oxygen transfer within the immobilization matrix. Compared with frustules adsorption and alginate encapsulation alone, the combined immobilized cells exhibited increases in catalytic activity of 32.8% and 17.3%, respectively. An in-situ immobilization protocol, adding 2.0 g/L frustules to the fermentation medium with a 22-h culture time, further improved immobilized cell activity by 17.3%. Moreover, frustule-adsorbed cells cross-linked with 0.5% glutaraldehyde (GA) exhibited enhanced catalytic performance in continuous batch operation. Finally, the repeated biotransformation was carried out by immobilized G. oxydans, achieving an average xylitol titer of 15.44 g/L over six consecutive batch cycles. This study presents a practical immobilization strategy for xylitol production and offers a reference for microbial production of other biochemicals.
papers.authors: Liu D, Guo JC, Liu L, Su JH, Cao SN, Yang BH, Zhang HL.

papers.title: "Illuminating" the silkworm chassis: Synthetic biology-driven evolution of genetic-based sexing circuits.
papers.abstract: The silkworm (Bombyx mori), a classical lepidopteran model, is evolving into a highly tractable synthetic biology chassis. In modern sericulture, genetic sexing circuits provide a rational design framework for efficient all-male rearing, effectively overcoming the gene dosage disruptions and fitness costs associated with traditional radiation-induced chromosomal translocations. This review systematically summarizes the construction strategies and industrial applications of these circuits. We outline the optimization of sex determination elements and highlight the advantages of far-red optical markers in penetrating host physical barriers and reducing cytotoxicity. Furthermore, we trace the evolution of genomic manipulation tools from random transposon insertions to targeted CRISPR/Cas9 integration into genomic safe harbors (GSHs). To address circuit instability during multigenerational rearing, protective molecular strategies-including boundary insulators, conditional expression, and automatic excision networks-are evaluated. We also explore the industrial interface that integrates standardized biological optical reporters with artificial intelligence and high-throughput optoelectronic sorting hardware. Ultimately, engineering principles derived from the silkworm chassis can provide a molecular framework for the sterile insect technique in global pest management, with future directions pointing toward footprint-free genome editing and dynamic conditional regulation.
papers.authors: Li C, Cao M, Li B.

enrichment.titleZh: “点亮”家蚕底盘：合成生物学驱动的遗传性别分选电路演进
enrichment.abstractZh: 家蚕（Bombyx mori）是经典的鳞翅目模式生物，正发展为一种易于操作的合成生物学底盘。在现代养蚕业中，遗传性别分选电路为高效全雄饲养提供了理性设计框架，可有效克服传统辐射诱导染色体易位造成的基因剂量失衡和适合度代价。本综述系统总结这些电路的构建策略与工业应用，概述性别决定元件的优化，并强调远红光标记在穿透宿主物理屏障和降低细胞毒性方面的优势。文章进一步梳理基因组操作工具从转座子随机插入向利用CRISPR/Cas9在基因组安全港（GSH）进行定点整合的演进。针对多代饲养中的电路不稳定问题，综述评估了边界绝缘子、条件性表达和自动切除网络等保护性分子策略，并探讨将标准化生物光学报告元件、人工智能与高通量光电分选硬件相整合的工业接口。最终，从家蚕底盘获得的工程原则可为全球害虫管理中的不育昆虫技术提供分子框架，未来方向包括无痕基因组编辑和动态条件调控。

papers.title: A cryptic lactate cycle in CO fermentation by Clostridium ljungdahlii .
papers.abstract: The valorization of C1 gases presents a route toward the utilization of industrial waste gases as resources. Acetogens such as Clostridium ljungdahlii serve as promising microbial cell factories for light-independent carbon fixation and high-value compound production, yet their efficiency is often limited by energy constraints and poorly understood metabolic pathways. Here, we investigated lactate metabolism in C. ljungdahlii during carbon monoxide (CO) fermentation via growth and product profiling, 13 C-labeling, gene knockouts, and transcriptomics. Although lactate cannot serve as the sole source of carbon and energy for C. ljungdahlii 's growth, we found that lactate can be co-fermented with CO into acetate. 13 C-tracing further revealed concurrent lactate production and oxidation during CO fermentation, with the unlabeled lactate fraction increasing from 1.0% (day 2) to 5.0% (day 6), indicating the existence of an active lactate cycle. Genetic and transcriptional analyses showed that lactate production and oxidation were catalyzed by two distinct lactate dehydrogenases: LdhA (CLJU_RS15865) and the electron-bifurcating Ldh/EtfAB_1 complex (CLJU_RS10590-CLJU_RS10600), respectively. Disruption of the lactate cycle, particularly in the Ldh/EtfAB_1 mutant, improved energy metabolism and triggered intracellular metabolic rearrangements. This mutant produced approximately 10-fold more lactate and shifted the acetate/ethanol ratio from 3.7:1 to 2.1:1, accompanied by upregulation of the AOR (aldehyde:ferredoxin oxidoreductase)-mediated ethanol production pathway. Subsequent ldhA overexpression further elevated lactate titer to ~2.5 mM, confirming the potential for lactate production from CO. The results imply that the cryptic lactate cycle dissipates energy but aids in intracellular redox balancing during CO fermentation. These findings provide new insights into the metabolic engineering of acetogens to produce target compounds, such as lactate and ethanol. Importance Acetogens possess a natural carbon fixation pathway, the Wood-Ljungdahl pathway, enabling them to fix CO or CO2 to produce acetate. Among various acetogens, Clostridium ljungdahlii exhibits strong tolerance to CO and thus holds great application potential for the resource utilization of syngas. However, the physiological and metabolic mechanisms underlying its autotrophic fermentation remain incompletely understood, which imposes limitations on metabolic engineering efforts. In this study, we systematically investigated lactate metabolism in C. ljungdahlii and revealed the existence of a cryptic lactate cycle during CO fermentation. By characterizing this cycle's operation and its impacts on energy metabolism and carbon distribution, we elucidated its potential physiological functions. These findings not only expand our understanding of the physiological and metabolic behaviors of acetogens during autotrophic fermentation but also provide theoretical guidance for the future metabolic engineering of lactate, ethanol, and other compounds.
papers.authors: Sun H, Yi J, Huang H, Wang S.

enrichment.titleZh: 杨氏梭菌 CO 发酵中隐蔽的乳酸循环
enrichment.abstractZh:
将 C1 气体转化为高价值产物，为工业废气资源化提供了一条途径。杨氏梭菌（Clostridium ljungdahlii）等产乙酸菌，是用于非光依赖型固碳及高价值化合物生产的有前景的微生物细胞工厂，但其效率往往受到能量限制及尚未充分认识的代谢途径制约。本研究通过生长与产物分析、¹³C 标记、基因敲除和转录组学，考察了杨氏梭菌在一氧化碳（CO）发酵过程中的乳酸代谢。虽然乳酸不能作为该菌生长的唯一碳源和能源，但研究者发现乳酸可与 CO 共发酵，转化为乙酸。¹³C 示踪进一步揭示，CO 发酵期间乳酸的生成和氧化同时发生；未标记乳酸的比例从第2天的1.0%增加到第6天的5.0%，表明存在活跃的乳酸循环。遗传和转录分析表明，乳酸生成与氧化分别由两种不同的乳酸脱氢酶催化：LdhA（CLJU_RS15865）及电子分岔型 Ldh/EtfAB_1 复合物（CLJU_RS10590—CLJU_RS10600）。破坏乳酸循环，尤其是在 Ldh/EtfAB_1 突变株中，可改善能量代谢并引起细胞内代谢重排。该突变株的乳酸产量约提高至10倍，乙酸/乙醇比从3.7:1变为2.1:1，同时 AOR（醛：铁氧还蛋白氧化还原酶）介导的乙醇生成途径上调。随后过表达 ldhA，使乳酸滴度进一步提高至约2.5 mM，证实了利用 CO 生产乳酸的潜力。结果提示，该隐蔽的乳酸循环在 CO 发酵期间消耗能量，但有助于维持细胞内氧化还原平衡。这些发现为通过产乙酸菌代谢工程生产乳酸、乙醇等目标化合物提供了新认识。

重要性：产乙酸菌具有天然固碳途径，即伍德—隆达尔途径，能够固定 CO 或 CO₂ 并生产乙酸。在不同产乙酸菌中，杨氏梭菌对 CO 具有较强耐受性，因此在合成气资源化方面拥有较大应用潜力。然而，其自养发酵的生理和代谢机制仍未得到充分认识，限制了代谢工程改造。本研究系统考察杨氏梭菌的乳酸代谢，揭示了 CO 发酵过程中隐蔽的乳酸循环。通过表征该循环的运行及其对能量代谢和碳分配的影响，研究者阐明了其潜在生理功能。这些发现不仅拓展了对产乙酸菌自养发酵生理代谢行为的认识，也为未来乳酸、乙醇及其他化合物的代谢工程改造提供了理论指导。

papers.title: Analysis of genome sequences of marine isolates of Saccharomyces cerevisiae
papers.abstract: Saccharomyces cerevisiae is the workhorse of the fermentation industry, as well as a dominant laboratory model organism and chassis for synthetic biology. The great majority of known isolates are from terrestrial sources, but a number of strains are reported to have been isolated from seawater and marine sediments and organisms. Marine strains may have superior tolerance to salt and fermentation inhibitors, and other properties which may be useful in industry, especially in processes based on seawater and marine biomass, as well as casting new light on the physiology and evolution of this species. We have recently reported the isolation of several marine strains of S. cerevisiae and comparisons with terrestrial strains for ethanol production. Here we describe the genome sequences of three marine S. cerevisiae strains, AZ65, AZ118 and AZ123. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first genome sequences of marine S. cerevisiae strains for which published isolation data are available. Superior salt and inhibitor tolerance of the strains, compared to multiple terrestrial and industrial comparators, was confirmed. Analysis of the ENA locus, believed to be related to salt tolerance in S. cerevisiae , did not show strong evidence for modification of copy number, protein sequence, or promoter sequence of this locus in response to a marine habitat. The physiological and genetic basis of salt and inhibitor tolerance thus remains to be determined.
papers.authors: Aslam MF, Zaky A, Hou X, Chen Y, Hu Y, French CE.
papers.status: 预印本 · 未经同行评审

papers.title: Biomanufacturing of L-Lactic Acid from Inulin Exploiting Kluyveromyces marxianus and Engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae Cell Factories.
papers.abstract: The transition to sustainable lactic acid (LA) biomanufacturing necessitates a shift from first-generation feedstocks toward residual biomass and low-pH fermentation, eliminating the costly, waste-intensive salt purification and acidification steps. This study presents a novel, two-yeast strategy designed to valorize inulin, a fructose polymer also found in cardoon roots, for high-efficiency LA production at a pH below its pKa. The key novelty of this work lies in identifying and pairing the unique physiological strengths of each organism: Kluyveromyces marxianus as the optimal yeast for inulin hydrolysis, and Saccharomyces cerevisiae as the superior host for robust LA production at low pH and high titers. We discovered that if ammonium sulphate is substituted with urea as a nitrogen source for K. marxianus cultivation, the inulinase activity increased by nearly 20-fold, significantly enhancing the initial breakdown of the substrate. Inulinase-enriched K. marxianus supernatant was then used to cultivate S. cerevisiae m850, an engineered homolactic strain, and convert inulin into L-LA. Comparing separate hydrolysis and fermentation (SHF) with simultaneous saccharification and fermentation (SSF), we achieved a maximal yield > 0.77 g/g with a final pH of 2.5. These results demonstrate a promising platform for producing LA from a residual feedstock, drastically reducing impacts and downstream processing costs.

enrichment.titleZh: 利用马克斯克鲁维酵母与工程酿酒酵母细胞工厂从菊粉生物制造L-乳酸
enrichment.abstractZh: 向可持续乳酸（LA）生物制造转型，需要从第一代原料转向剩余生物质及低pH发酵，以省去成本高、废物产生量大的盐纯化和酸化步骤。本研究提出一种新的双酵母策略，利用菊粉这种也存在于刺蓟（cardoon）根部的果糖聚合物，在低于乳酸pKa的pH条件下高效生产乳酸。工作的主要创新在于识别并配合利用两种微生物各自独特的生理优势：马克斯克鲁维酵母（Kluyveromyces marxianus）是菊粉水解的最佳酵母，酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）则是更适合在低pH下稳健、高滴度生产乳酸的宿主。研究发现，培养K. marxianus时，如果以尿素替代硫酸铵作为氮源，菊粉酶活性可提高近20倍，从而显著增强底物的初始分解。随后，利用富含菊粉酶的K. marxianus培养上清培养同型乳酸发酵工程菌株S. cerevisiae m850，将菊粉转化为L-乳酸。在比较分步水解与发酵（SHF）和同步糖化与发酵（SSF）后，研究者获得了>0.77 g/g的最高得率，最终pH为2.5。SSF受到pH引起的菊粉酶失活限制，而SHF工艺实现了底物完全转化。这些结果展示了利用剩余原料生产乳酸的有前景平台，可显著降低相关影响及下游加工成本。
enrichment.sourceTitle: Biomanufacturing of L-Lactic Acid from Inulin Exploiting Kluyveromyces marxianus and Engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae Cell Factories.
enrichment.sourceAbstract: The transition to sustainable lactic acid (LA) biomanufacturing necessitates a shift from first-generation feedstocks toward residual biomass and low-pH fermentation, eliminating the costly, waste-intensive salt purification and acidification steps. While SSF was limited by pH-induced inulinase inactivation, the SHF process achieved complete substrate conversion. These results demonstrate a promising platform for producing LA from a residual feedstock, drastically reducing impacts and downstream processing costs.

papers.title: Carbon-Convergent Co-utilization of Ethanol and CO2 Enables Efficient 3-Hydroxypropionic Acid Biosynthesis in Komagataella phaffii
papers.abstract: Abstract CO 2 is an abundant feedstock for biomanufacturing, but its high oxidation state demands substantial reducing power for multicarbon biosynthesis. Here, we establish a carbon-convergent strategy for producing 3-hydroxypropionic acid (3-HP) through the co-utilization of ethanol and inorganic carbon in engineered Komagataella phaffii. Ethanol serves as a nexus molecule that supplies a conserved C2 backbone together with reducing equivalents, enabling a "2+1=3" route to 3-HP through inorganic C1 incorporation. Coordinated engineering of ethanol assimilation, acetate activation, carboxylation, cofactor supply, and energy metabolism generated strain LT-28, which produced 127.04 g/L 3-HP, the highest titer reported so far for CO 2 -based biosynthesis. 13C tracing verified the joint contribution of ethanol-derived C2 carbon and inorganic C1 carbon to the product skeleton. LT-28 also converted an unpurified ethanol-rich stream from thermocatalytic CO2 reduction into 3-HP. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of coupling chemical CO 2 reduction with microbial 3-HP biosynthesis through ethanol-mediated carbon convergence.
papers.authors: Liu J, Liu T, Lei H, Chen Z, Zhu Y, Mao Y, Feng J, Zeng A.
papers.status: 预印本 · 未经同行评审

enrichment.titleZh: 乙醇与CO₂的碳汇聚协同利用实现Komagataella phaffii中3-羟基丙酸的高效生物合成
enrichment.abstractZh: 摘要：CO₂是一种丰富的生物制造原料，但其高氧化态使多碳化合物的生物合成需要大量还原力。本研究在工程化Komagataella phaffii中建立了一种碳汇聚策略，通过协同利用乙醇和无机碳生产3-羟基丙酸（3-HP）。乙醇作为枢纽分子，在提供得以保留的C2骨架的同时提供还原当量，从而通过并入无机C1碳，实现通向3-HP的“2+1=3”路线。通过协同改造乙醇同化、乙酸活化、羧化、辅因子供应及能量代谢，研究者获得了LT-28菌株，其3-HP滴度达到127.04 g/L，是迄今报道的基于CO₂生物合成的最高滴度。¹³C示踪证实，乙醇来源的C2碳和无机C1碳共同参与构成产物骨架。LT-28还将来自CO₂热催化还原的、未经纯化的富乙醇物料流转化为3-HP。这些发现证明，通过乙醇介导的碳汇聚，将CO₂化学还原与微生物3-HP生物合成相耦合是可行的。

papers.title: Comparative Multi-omics Reveals Conserved Membrane Architecture and Selective Metabolic Cargo Enrichment Across Yeast-Derived Extracellular Vesicles
papers.abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are fundamental mediators of intercellular communication across all kingdoms of life, yet our understanding of EV biology has been derived predominantly from mammalian systems. In contrast, yeast-derived extracellular vesicles (YDEVs) remain poorly characterized despite their potential as scalable, non-pathogenic platforms for biotechnology and metabolic engineering. Here, we combined a high-yield isolation workflow with comparative multi-omics to define the metabolically active cargo and membrane composition of EVs derived from three yeast species and four strains: the conventional model yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae (SC), the non-model oleaginous yeast Rhodotorula toruloides (RT-88), and two Yarrowia lipolytica strains, wild-type W29 and its engineered derivative Po1f. Using tangential flow filtration coupled with ultracentrifugation, we reproducibly isolated intact, bilayer-enclosed vesicles with conserved nanoscale morphology across all strains despite marked differences in EV yield. Comparative metabolomics revealed selective enrichment of distinct metabolically active cargo, including nucleotide metabolites in SC, fatty acids and acyl-carnitines in RT-88, and strain-specific metabolites within the Yarrowia isolates. Notably, nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD⁺) was enriched in SC and RT-88 EVs but was nearly absent from Yarrowia -derived vesicles, raising the possibility that EV encapsulation may facilitate protected transport of this otherwise membrane-impermeable cofactor. In contrast to these differences in cargo composition, comparative lipidomics demonstrated a broadly conserved membrane architecture across all strains, with only quantitative remodeling of specific lipid classes and membrane unsaturation profiles. Together, these findings support an organizational principle in which yeast-derived extracellular vesicles preserve a conserved membrane architecture while selectively enriching metabolically active cargo, establishing a comparative framework for understanding EV biology across evolutionarily diverse yeast species. enrichment.titleZh: 比较多组学揭示酵母源细胞外囊泡中保守的膜结构与代谢活性载荷的选择性富集
enrichment.abstractZh:

papers.title: Coupled physicochemical and microbial recovery of aged premise plumbing following water-supply interruption.
papers.abstract: Water-supply interruptions can cause pronounced deterioration of premise-plumbing water quality, yet the coordinated responses of bacterial communities, antibiotic resistance, bacteriophages, and microbial functional potential during water-supply resumption remain poorly resolved. Here, a full-scale 24-h water-supply interruption in an approximately 25-year-old cast-iron premise-plumbing system was investigated by integrating physicochemical measurements, quantitative PCR, metagenomics, virus-host prediction, and functional analyses. At 1 min after water supply resumption, residual chlorine was undetectable, whereas turbidity and total iron ranged from 149.9 to 155.3 NTU and 13.4 to 13.8 mg/L, respectively. By 40 min, residual chlorine reached 0.52 to 0.56 mg/L, while turbidity and total iron declined to levels of 0.56 to 0.61 NTU and 0.028 to 0.041 mg/L, respectively. Concurrently, Legionella pneumophila decreased from 4.12 to 0.83 log 10 (gene copies/mL), and mexA from 5.55 to 1.77 log 10 (gene copies/mL). Metagenomic analyses revealed pronounced succession of bacterial communities, putative human pathogen-associated taxa, and the resistome. Caudoviricetes dominated the viral community and showed coordinated temporal changes with predicted bacterial hosts. Biofilm-associated functional genes, extracellular polymeric substances (EPS), and putative phage-encoded auxiliary metabolic genes were more abundant in the initially discharged water and generally decreased following water supply resumption. The elevated EPS may have reflected both microbial production and detachment of pre-existing biofilm-associated material. Collectively, the results identify the initially discharged water as a distinct post-stagnation physicochemical and microbiological state. Water-supply resumption represents a rapid ecological transition in which restoration of disinfectant residual and displacement of stagnant/pipe-associated material jointly restructure the microbiome, resistome, and virome.
papers.authors: Mi X, Wang Z, Ran M, Shi B, Wang H.

papers.title: Dynamic tapered nozzle and multiple waveform modulation enable high-speed piezoelectric jetting without satellite droplets across broad fluid property ranges.
papers.abstract: Piezoelectric drop-on-demand inkjet printing enables controlled microdroplet deposition in microfluidics, biomanufacturing, and precision manufacturing. However, conventional pressure chamber piezoelectric printheads are susceptible to viscous dissipation and nozzle clogging, exhibit limited adaptability to high-viscosity, low-surface-tension liquids and particle/cell suspensions, and struggle to suppress satellite droplets effectively. These limitations hinder their practical deployment in high-precision and high-stability inkjet applications. Here, a dynamic tapered nozzle generates droplets through local self-pumping induced by geometric deformation rather than pressure-wave propagation in a conventional pressure chamber. Structural optimization enabled droplet velocities of 5.42-12.67 m s -1 and stable ejection at viscosities up to 40.3 mPa s, surface tensions of 24.44-72.75 mN m -1 , and Z values of 1.01-38.11. Mechanistic analysis identified high-frequency residual nozzle oscillations as the primary cause of ligament stretching and secondary breakup. Based on this mechanism, a multiple waveform modulation strategy is devised to dynamically regulate the nozzle displacement response. This strategy effectively suppresses satellite droplets during high-speed ejection while maintaining printing throughput and achieves a 32% reduction in droplet diameter. The satellite-droplet suppression effect is further validated in a 0.5 wt% SiO 2 nanoparticle suspension and a 10 wt% PVP K30 solution. The platform enables high-viability printing of MC3T3 cells and carrier-free intracellular delivery of 70 kDa fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC)-dextran, establishing a feasible pathway for high-speed and stable ejection across broad fluid property ranges with low clogging risk.
papers.authors: Chen J, Xu C, Wang M, Ji S, Dai Y, Chen X.

enrichment.titleZh: 动态锥形喷嘴与多波形调制实现宽流体性质范围内无卫星液滴的高速压电喷射
enrichment.abstractZh: 压电按需喷墨打印能够在微流控、生物制造和精密制造中实现微液滴的可控沉积。然而，传统压力腔式压电打印头易受黏性耗散和喷嘴堵塞影响，对高黏度、低表面张力液体及颗粒/细胞悬浮液的适应性有限，也难以有效抑制卫星液滴。这些限制阻碍了其在高精度、高稳定性喷墨应用中的实际部署。本研究通过动态锥形喷嘴，利用几何变形诱导的局部自泵送作用生成液滴，而非依赖传统压力腔中的压力波传播。结构优化使液滴速度达到5.42—12.67 m/s，并可在黏度最高40.3 mPa·s、表面张力24.44—72.75 mN/m及 Z 值1.01—38.11的条件下稳定喷射。机制分析确定，喷嘴的高频残余振动是液丝拉伸及二次破裂的主要原因。基于该机制，研究者设计了多波形调制策略，以动态调节喷嘴的位移响应。该策略在保持打印通量的同时，有效抑制高速喷射中的卫星液滴，并使液滴直径减小32%。对0.5 wt% SiO₂ 纳米颗粒悬浮液及10 wt% PVP K30 溶液的试验进一步验证了卫星液滴抑制效果。该平台可实现 MC3T3 细胞的高存活率打印，并将70 kDa 异硫氰酸荧光素（FITC）-葡聚糖无载体递送至细胞内，为在宽流体性质范围内以较低堵塞风险实现高速、稳定喷射提供了一条可行路径。

papers.title: Enhanced violacein production by synthetically engineered mutualistic Escherichia coli co-culture biofilms in a spatially partitioned bioreactor system.
papers.abstract: Violacein (VIO) is a bacterial secondary metabolite with potential applications in healthcare, textile, and cosmetic industries. Although modular synthetic E. coli co-cultures are promising for biomanufacturing, VIO production in such systems depends on efficient cross-feeding, which requires spatial proximity and stable interactions among co-culture members. Here, we demonstrate that a spatially partitioned bioreactor can support coexisting suspended and carrier-associated states of a mutualistic recombinant E. coli co-culture, enabling direct comparison of their crude VIO production performance. The co-culture was cultivated in a spatially partitioned bioreactor consisting of an aerobic stirred-tank compartment connected to an oxygen-limited cartridge containing Fibra-Cel® discs as carriers, thereby enabling biomass partitioning into suspended and adherent fractions. Across three biological replicates, the adherent biofilm-associated fraction consistently exhibited higher biomass-normalized crude VIO production than the corresponding suspended fraction, with 4.51-, 20.05-, and 5.51-fold increases. Although the adherent fraction represented only 10.6-24.0% of the total biomass, it contributed 35.4-86.3% of the total crude VIO. These results show that carrier-associated spatial organization within the partitioned bioreactor supported the formation of highly productive biofilm-associated E. coli co-culture populations. The presented concept highlights the potential of spatially organized, carrier-associated co-cultures for the intensification of secondary metabolite production and future biofilm-based bioprocessing applications.
papers.authors: Gupta S, Takors R.

enrichment.titleZh: 在空间分隔生物反应器中利用合成工程化互利大肠杆菌共培养生物膜提高紫色杆菌素产量
enrichment.abstractZh: 紫色杆菌素（violacein，VIO）是一种细菌次级代谢物，在医疗保健、纺织和化妆品行业具有潜在应用。虽然模块化合成大肠杆菌（E. coli）共培养体系有望用于生物制造，但其中 VIO 的生产依赖高效的交叉供养，而这需要共培养成员在空间上接近并维持稳定相互作用。本研究表明，空间分隔生物反应器可使互利重组大肠杆菌共培养体系同时以悬浮态和载体附着态共存，从而能够直接比较两种状态的粗制 VIO 生产性能。该共培养体系在空间分隔生物反应器中培养：好氧搅拌罐室与一个限氧柱式单元连接，后者装有作为载体的 Fibra-Cel® 圆片，使生物量分为悬浮组分与黏附组分。在3个生物学重复中，黏附于生物膜的组分按生物量归一化的粗制 VIO 产量均高于相应悬浮组分，分别达到其4.51倍、20.05倍和5.51倍。尽管黏附组分只占总生物量的10.6%—24.0%，却贡献了总粗制 VIO 的35.4%—86.3%。这些结果表明，分隔反应器内与载体关联的空间组织方式，支持形成高生产能力的生物膜相关大肠杆菌共培养群体。该概念展示了空间组织化、载体附着型共培养体系在强化次级代谢物生产，以及未来基于生物膜的生物加工应用中的潜力。

papers.title: Genetic control couples TGF β -independent pluripotent stem cell renewal to deterministic forward programming across germ layers
papers.abstract: Reproducible and scalable manufacture of human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) derivatives requires control over expansion and differentiation. Transcription factor-mediated forward programming can place hiPSC differentiation under genetic control, but expansion still relies on extracellular growth-factor supplementation, increasing process complexity and operator dependence. enrichment.titleZh: 遗传控制将不依赖TGFβ的多能干细胞自我更新与跨胚层的确定性正向编程相耦合
enrichment.abstractZh: 要可重复、可规模化地制造人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）衍生细胞，需要控制其扩增与分化。转录因子介导的正向编程可使hiPSC分化受到遗传控制，但扩增仍依赖外源补充生长因子，从而增加工艺复杂性及对操作者的依赖。本研究提出GERALT，即遗传增强的自我更新与自主谱系转分化（Genetically Enhanced Renewal and Autonomous Lineage Transdifferentiation）。这是一种通过靶向安全港位点整合而组装的推拉式基因回路，将由NANOG支持、不依赖TGFβ的自我更新，与多西环素诱导的谱系编程及同步发生的NANOG沉默相耦合。在长时间撤除TGFβ的条件下，GERALT在贴壁培养与悬浮培养中均能维持多能性，同时仍可被编程为肌源性、神经元及肝细胞命运。在肌生成方面，与已建立的OPTi-OX平台相比，GERALT能够在简化培养基中实现分化，同时使命运决定过程更加定向并加快这一过程。GERALT还支持在悬浮培养中直接进行肌源性编程，并能将hiPSC直接浇注到水凝胶中，随后在组织内进行编程，获得能够对电刺激作出反应的工程化肌肉组织。这些结果将遗传控制向上游延伸至干细胞自我更新，有助于新方法学（new approach methodologies）及其他生物制造应用的实施。

papers.title: Kinetic metabolic modeling of Saccharomyces cerevisiae mutants reveals two major regulatory patterns of glycolytic flux control.
papers.abstract: Maintaining a high glycolytic flux is critical for robust ethanol fermentation and metabolic engineering in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. However, the regulatory mechanisms that prevent the excess turbo design structure of glycolysis under genetic perturbations are unknown. In this study, we constructed a kinetic model of yeast central carbon metabolism encompassing 90 reactions and 543 parameters. Using a genetic algorithm, we trained the model ensemble using multi-omics datasets (proteomics, metabolomics, and fluxomics) collected from the wild-type strain and 11 single-gene deletion mutants. Metabolic control analysis (MCA) of the calibrated models revealed that two major regulatory modes governed the glycolytic flux in most of the strains examined under the culture condition used in this study, although gcr2Δ exhibited a distinct control profile and gnd1Δ could not be reproduced by the model. The wild-type, gcn4Δ, and rpe1Δ strains exhibited an HXK-limited control mode, in which lowered hexokinase activity likely acts as a feedback limiter to prevent pathway over-activation. Conversely, seven other mutants shifted to an ATP demand-coupled mode, transferring flux control to energy-dissipating reactions and linking glycolytic flux directly to ATP demand. No single motif was uniformly shared within either group, implying that strain-specific expression adjustments repeatedly resulted in two regulatory modes. These findings elucidate the robust, multimodal control strategies employed by yeast to safeguard its high fermentation capacity and provide a theoretical foundation for targeted metabolic engineering and robust bioprocess design.
papers.authors: Sato G, Yamasaki K, Okahashi N, Matsuda F.

enrichment.titleZh: 酿酒酵母突变株的动力学代谢建模揭示糖酵解通量控制的两种主要调控模式
enrichment.abstractZh: 维持高糖酵解通量，对酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）稳健的乙醇发酵及代谢工程至关重要。然而，在遗传扰动下，防止糖酵解“涡轮式设计”结构过度激活的调控机制仍不清楚。本研究构建了包含90个反应和543个参数的酵母中心碳代谢动力学模型。研究者利用遗传算法，使用野生型菌株和11个单基因缺失突变株的多组学数据集（蛋白质组学、代谢组学及通量组学）训练模型集合。对校准模型开展代谢控制分析（MCA）发现，在本研究采用的培养条件下，所考察的大多数菌株主要由两种调控模式控制糖酵解通量；不过，gcr2Δ 表现出不同的控制特征，而模型无法重现 gnd1Δ 的行为。野生型、gcn4Δ 和 rpe1Δ 菌株表现为己糖激酶（HXK）受限的控制模式：降低的己糖激酶活性可能发挥反馈限流作用，以防止途径过度激活。相反，另外7个突变株转向 ATP 需求耦合模式，将通量控制转移到耗能反应，使糖酵解通量直接与 ATP 需求相联系。两组内部均未发现一致共享的单一调控基序，这意味着不同菌株各自的表达调整反复形成了这两种调控模式。这些发现阐明了酵母为维持高发酵能力而采用的稳健、多模式控制策略，并为靶向代谢工程和稳健生物工艺设计提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Marrow-mimicry MEW scaffolds recapitulate erythroblastic islands for high-density cRBC biomanufacturing
papers.abstract: Biomanufactured cell therapies are delivering a step-change in modern medicine, but their high costs have prevented widespread adoption. Cultured red blood cells (cRBCs) are one type of cell therapy in clinical trials for off-the-shelf blood transfusion but remain limited by the exorbitant costs of manufacturing trillions of RBCs required for a blood transfusion. These costs could be mitigated if culture platforms could grow cells at higher density, like those found in the bone marrow, requiring less media and lower concentrations of expensive growth factors per cell. We engineered melt electrowritten (MEW) polycaprolactone (PCL) scaffolds in geometries which imitate marrow trabeculae structures and were then plasma-treated to enable peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PB MNC) attachment. PB MNC monocytes first adhered to the scaffold and rapidly differentiated into CD68 + macrophage-like cells. These macrophage-loaded scaffolds adhered CD71 + erythroblasts, which then grew from 10 to 25% between days 4 and 8 and produced CD235a + erythroid cells by day 20, under erythrogenic culture conditions. MEW PCL scaffolds in trabecular-like geometries had greater surface area, adhered more macrophages, and generated more erythroblasts than traditional MEW crosshatch geometries. The MEW scaffolds continuously released less-adherent cells to the supernatant, providing a 74% increase in supernatant cell numbers versus liquid suspension controls with identical cell seeding numbers and media volumes. High-cell-density scaffolds exhibited increased metabolism and endogenous production of self-supportive cytokines, which may offer cost-saving opportunities through future media optimisation. This study reports marrow trabeculae-mimetic MEW PCL designs capable of selectively adhering PB MN cells to develop macrophage-coated scaffolds, which provided physical and paracrine support for cRBC production. This high-cell-density culture platform may be useful for future cell therapy biomanufacturing protocols.

enrichment.titleZh: 仿骨髓熔融静电直写支架重现幼红细胞岛，用于培养红细胞的高密度生物制造
enrichment.abstractZh: 生物制造的细胞疗法正在给现代医学带来显著进步，但高成本阻碍了其广泛应用。培养红细胞（cRBC）是一类正处于临床试验阶段、拟用于即用型输血的细胞治疗产品；然而，一次输血所需的数万亿个红细胞（RBC）的制造成本极高，仍然限制着其应用。如果培养平台能够像骨髓中那样，以更高密度培养细胞，使每个细胞所需的培养基更少、昂贵生长因子的使用浓度更低，则可能降低这些成本。研究者通过熔融静电直写（MEW）制造聚己内酯（PCL）支架，使其几何形状模仿骨髓中的骨小梁结构，随后经等离子体处理，以支持外周血单个核细胞（PB MNC）附着。PB MNC中的单核细胞首先黏附于支架，并迅速分化为CD68⁺巨噬细胞样细胞。这些负载巨噬细胞的支架进一步黏附CD71⁺幼红细胞；在红系诱导培养条件下，幼红细胞的比例从第4天的10%增加至第8天的25%，并在第20天产生CD235a⁺红系细胞。与传统的MEW交叉网格几何形状相比，仿骨小梁几何形状的MEW PCL支架具有更大的表面积，可黏附更多巨噬细胞，并生成更多幼红细胞。MEW支架持续将黏附性较弱的细胞释放到培养上清中；在细胞接种数量与培养基体积相同的条件下，其上清细胞数比液体悬浮培养对照增加74%。高细胞密度支架表现出更活跃的代谢，并内源性产生支持自身生长的细胞因子，这可能为未来通过优化培养基降低成本提供机会。本研究报告了仿骨髓骨小梁结构的MEW PCL设计，能够选择性黏附外周血单个核细胞，形成覆盖巨噬细胞的支架，为培养红细胞的生产提供物理与旁分泌支持。这一高细胞密度培养平台可能适用于未来的细胞治疗生物制造流程。

papers.title: Multilevel metabolic engineering of Bacillus amyloliquefaciens for enhanced L-tyrosine production.
papers.abstract: L-Tyrosine is a valuable aromatic amino acid with diverse applications. Although plasmid-based overexpression has markedly improved L-tyrosine production, the dependence on antibiotic selection and genetic instability under nonselective conditions limits its industrial applicability. To address these issues, this study employed a multi-level metabolic engineering strategy to enhance the L-tyrosine biosynthetic pathway at the genomic level in Bacillus amyloliquefaciens. First, an expression cassette containing the mutant prephenate dehydrogenase (TyrA I309A/E330V ) was inserted into the genome of the wild-type strain Z1. When the copy number reached three (strain Z4), L-tyrosine production reached 437.43 mg/L. Subsequently, the mutant DAHP synthase (AroA R27A/K38A ) was integrated, and the resulting two-copy strain Z7 increased L-tyrosine production to 591.29 mg/L. Systematic identification of rate-limiting steps showed that most pathway genes enhanced production to varying extents. A promoter in situ replacement strategy was then applied to construct strain Z21, which further increased the titer to 813.01 mg/L. Finally, by optimizing precursor supply, the engineered strain Z32 reached an L-tyrosine titer of 1079.94 mg/L. Overall, this plasmid-free and antibiotic-independent platform offers a promising strategy for stable biosynthesis of L-tyrosine and other aromatic amino acids in microbial cell factories.
papers.authors: Zhang D, Jiang P, Wang L, Gu J, Ji A, Feng N.

enrichment.titleZh: 以多层次代谢工程提高解淀粉芽孢杆菌的L-酪氨酸产量
enrichment.abstractZh: L-酪氨酸是一种用途广泛的高价值芳香族氨基酸。虽然基于质粒的过表达已经明显提高了L-酪氨酸产量，但依赖抗生素筛选，以及在非选择性条件下存在遗传不稳定性，限制了其工业应用。为解决这些问题，本研究采用多层次代谢工程策略，在解淀粉芽孢杆菌（Bacillus amyloliquefaciens）的基因组层面增强L-酪氨酸生物合成途径。首先，将含有突变型预苯酸脱氢酶TyrA（I309A/E330V）的表达盒插入野生型菌株Z1的基因组。当拷贝数达到3个时，所得菌株Z4的L-酪氨酸滴度达到437.43 mg/L。随后整合突变型DAHP合酶AroA（R27A/K38A），所得双拷贝菌株Z7的L-酪氨酸滴度提高至591.29 mg/L。对限速步骤的系统性辨识表明，大多数途径基因都能不同程度地提高产量。接着，研究者通过启动子原位替换构建菌株Z21，使滴度进一步提高到813.01 mg/L。最后，通过优化前体供应，工程菌株Z32的L-酪氨酸滴度达到1079.94 mg/L。总体而言，这一无质粒、不依赖抗生素的平台，为微生物细胞工厂稳定生物合成L-酪氨酸及其他芳香族氨基酸提供了一种有前景的策略。

papers.title: Protein resource allocation across subcellular compartments revealed by large-scale absolute quantitative proteomics in yeast.
papers.abstract: Subcellular compartmentalization within complex membrane-bound organelles is a hallmark of eukaryal life, enabling metabolic specialization through spatial segregation. Here, we compiled a dataset encompassing 300 absolute quantitative proteomes, the largest to date, across two yeast species under diverse experimental conditions. Leveraging big data analysis, formula fitting, and machine learning, quantitative correlations among protein abundance, resource allocation, and cellular phenotypes were elucidated at a system level. We found that subcellular resource distribution is highly uneven and covaries with specific growth rate. Specifically, at high specific growth rates, the protein mass fraction (PMF) from certain compartments, (e.g., nucleus) is consistently reduced, coinciding with the increasing protein resource demand from ribosomes. Meanwhile, nutrient limitation may induce resource recycling by upregulating protein resources within specific compartments (e.g., vacuole) to sustain stress adaptation. Importantly, our integrative analysis indicates that PMF from a few subcellular compartments (e.g., nucleus and ribosomes) can accurately predict yeast physiological parameters (e.g., specific growth rate, oxygen uptake rate), and a limited protein set (≥ 23) could be used to capture the variation in resource allocation across seven major subcellular compartments. Furthermore, our comparative analysis between Crabtree-positive and Crabtree-negative species across conditions illustrates that subcellular resource allocation could be shaped by multiple factors and the two species differ markedly in their robustness to environmental perturbations. In summary, the high-quality quantitative proteomic dataset for yeast species offers an unprecedented opportunity for understanding the general principles underlying subcellular resource allocation, laying foundations for precision engineering of cell factories in synthetic biology.
papers.authors: Lu H, Zhang Z, He S, Zhang Y, Wang Y, Tao F, Nielsen J.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

enrichment.titleZh: 酵母大规模绝对定量蛋白质组学揭示亚细胞区室间的蛋白质资源分配
enrichment.abstractZh: 由复杂膜结合细胞器形成的亚细胞区室化是真核生命的重要特征，可通过空间分隔实现代谢功能特化。本研究汇编了涵盖300个绝对定量蛋白质组的数据集，是迄今规模最大的此类数据集，覆盖两种酵母及多种实验条件。通过大数据分析、公式拟合和机器学习，研究者在系统层面解析了蛋白质丰度、资源分配与细胞表型之间的定量关联。结果发现，亚细胞资源分布高度不均，并随比生长速率共同变化。具体而言，在较高比生长速率下，某些区室（如细胞核）的蛋白质质量分数（PMF）持续降低，同时核糖体对蛋白质资源的需求增加。另一方面，营养限制可能通过上调特定区室（如液泡）中的蛋白质资源来促进资源回收，从而维持胁迫适应。综合分析表明，少数亚细胞区室（如细胞核和核糖体）的PMF可准确预测酵母生理参数，例如比生长速率和摄氧速率；有限的蛋白质集合（≥23种）即可用于捕捉7个主要亚细胞区室间资源分配的变化。此外，对Crabtree效应阳性和阴性物种在不同条件下的比较显示，亚细胞资源分配可能受多种因素影响，两种酵母对环境扰动的稳健性存在明显差异。总体而言，这一高质量酵母定量蛋白质组数据集为理解亚细胞资源分配的一般原理提供了前所未有的机会，并为合成生物学中细胞工厂的精准工程改造奠定基础。

papers.title: RapidKnock enables fast linear programming-based knockout search for microbial strain design.
papers.abstract: Identifying reaction knockout strategies that redirect metabolic flux toward overproduction of a desired metabolite is a central computational challenge in metabolic engineering. Classical strain design tools, e.g. OptKnock, rely on mixed-integer linear programming, are typically run with commercial solvers for genome-scale problems, and return a single solution. Exhaustive enumeration methods such as FastKnock avoid the commercial solver dependency by relying on linear programming alone, but at the cost of execution times that scale into the hours-to-days range. Here we describe RapidKnock, an iterative search algorithm that relies on linear programming, using flux variability analysis to prune the knockout candidate space and flux balance analysis to identify and lock in high-yield knockout combinations. On the Escherichia coli iAF1260 genome-scale metabolic model under succinate-production conditions, RapidKnock identified knockout strategies faster than OptKnock, by at least 1.45-fold in the larger quadruple-knockout case, while returning a ranked pool of alternative solutions. On the Aspergillus niger iJB1325 genome-scale metabolic model, used as a computational stress test for oxaloacetate overproduction, RapidKnock identified viable knockout strategies where both OptKnock and FastKnock failed to return any solution within the allotted computation time. RapidKnock runs on free open-source solvers and, on the cases tested here, returns results faster and with more ranked alternatives than OptKnock and FastKnock.
papers.authors: Chowdhury NB.

papers.title: Recent biotechnological advances and technology readiness level of natural products derived from marine fungi.
papers.abstract: Bioprospecting involves the systematic exploration of natural resources to identify bioactive secondary metabolites with potential for development into commercially valuable products. In this review, more than a hundred bioactive compounds derived from marine fungi were analysed, with emphasis on their chemical diversity, biological activities, commercialisation status, economic relevance, and Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs). The compounds represented diverse metabolite classes, including polyketides, alkaloids, terpenoids, peptides, azaphilones, and other bioactive secondary metabolites with pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmeceutical, industrial, and environmental applications. Among the reviewed compounds, only approximately 10-20 have been marketed, while the majority remain at early stages of development. TRL assessment showed that most marine fungal-derived products are concentrated at TRL 1-3, a smaller number of compounds and bioprocesses have progressed to TRL 4-5, and highly commercialised products reach TRL 9. In India, pharmaceutical applications involving anticancer, antimicrobial, and antiviral compounds were assessed at TRL 3-5, nutraceuticals at TRL 5-7, cosmeceuticals at TRL 6-8, and industrial enzymes at TRL 7-9. The main barriers to commercialisation were low and unstable metabolite yields, structural complexity, regulatory and bioprospecting constraints, inadequate translational investment and industrial infrastructure, and high financial and technical risks during late-stage development. Integrated approaches including strain improvement, fermentation optimization, chemoenzymatic synthesis, OSMAC, in-situ product removal, genome mining, metabolic engineering, Chemi-genomic approaches, and CRISPR/Cas-based pathway engineering offer opportunities to improve production and increase TRLs. Overall, the findings demonstrate a substantial discovery-to-commercialization gap in marine fungal biotechnology. Advancing strain development, scalable bioprocessing, safety and regulatory validation, synthetic biology, industrial partnerships, and translational infrastructure is essential to convert promising low-TRL discoveries into commercially viable products and strengthen the contribution of marine fungi to a sustainable circular bioeconomy. papers.title: Standards in systems and synthetic biology: status, developments, and tools in 2026.
papers.abstract: For over a decade, the Journal of Integrative Bioinformatics has published special issues providing updated specifications for standards in systems biology and synthetic biology. Beginning in 2024, the special issues expanded to include novel or refined tools that leverage these standards or play a key role in their implementation. The current special issue contains four updated specifications and two tools or libraries. In addition, this document functions as a comprehensive reference for all COMBINE standard specifications, ensuring researchers and practitioners can access the most up-to-date versions available in the field.

papers.title: Substantiation of CcmB as heme extruder exploitable for microbial production of secretory heme.
papers.abstract: Heme, a redox-active cofactor for vital processes across all domains of life, has widespread applications in healthcare and food supplement industries. However, heme in excess not only inhibits its own synthesis but also is highly cytotoxic, becoming a hindrance for microbial production of heme. In order to pin down heme exporters exploitable for production of secretory heme in bacteria, in this study, we carried out a comprehensive comparative study of heme exporters known to date, CydDC, HrtAB, and CcmABC(D). While CydDC proteins are ubiquitous, homologs of HrtAB and CcmABC(D) are restricted to Gram + and proteobacteria respectively. We substantiate that CcmB, rather than CcmC or CcmCD, are able to extrude heme out of the membrane, a mechanism shared by HrtB and HrtAB but not CydDC. By expressing CcmB in engineered high-performance heme-producing strains of Escherichia coli, secretory heme production is substantially improved. Our findings offer a solution for high-yield microbial bioproduction of secretory heme with industrial and medical applications.
papers.authors: Yang H, Zhang F, Gu J, Gao H.

papers.title: SynBioFooDB: a comprehensive resource for synthetic biology-driven food biomanufacturing.
papers.abstract: Enabled by synthetic biology and metabolic engineering, microbial biomanufacturing is reshaping the production of food-related compounds by offering sustainable alternatives to resource-intensive extraction and conventional chemical synthesis. However, information linking food-related compounds to biosynthetic pathways and microbial biomanufacturing evidence remains fragmented across the literature and poorly represented in existing food-oriented resources, hindering cross-study comparison, evidence synthesis, and rational design of microbial production systems. Here, we present SynBioFooDB (https://synbiofoodb.biodesign.ac.cn/), a knowledgebase dedicated to synthetic biology-driven food biomanufacturing. SynBioFooDB integrates 74 237 food-related compounds with standardized chemical identities and annotations covering food occurrence, bioactivity, toxicity, and regulatory information. It further provides expert-curated biomanufacturing evidence for 1054 compounds from 5592 publications, linking microbial hosts, substrates, genetic modifications, and quantitative production metrics through structured and traceable records. The database also contains 2002 literature-reported biosynthetic pathways for 971 compounds, enabling comparison of alternative precursors, enzyme combinations, and pathway architectures. For compounds without literature-reported pathways, SynBioFooDB provides computationally predicted candidate pathways to facilitate pathway prioritization and experimental evaluation. By integrating compound-level context, biomanufacturing evidence, and biosynthetic pathway information, SynBioFooDB supports systematic exploration, comparison, and rational design of microbial production strategies for food-related compounds.
papers.authors: Wei F, Deng X, Li H, Wang R, Mao Z, Mao Y, Liu Y, Niu Q, Qin Y, Du J, Liao X, Bai Y, Yuan Q, Ma H.

enrichment.titleZh: SynBioFooDB：合成生物学驱动食品生物制造的综合资源库
enrichment.abstractZh: 在合成生物学和代谢工程的推动下，微生物生物制造正通过提供可持续替代路线，改变食品相关化合物的生产方式，以减少对资源密集型提取和传统化学合成的依赖。然而，将食品相关化合物与生物合成途径及微生物生物制造证据关联起来的信息仍分散在文献中，现有食品导向资源对这些信息的覆盖也不足，阻碍了跨研究比较、证据整合及微生物生产系统的理性设计。本文介绍专门面向合成生物学驱动食品生物制造的知识库SynBioFooDB（https://synbiofoodb.biodesign.ac.cn/）。该库整合了74 237种食品相关化合物，提供标准化化学身份标识，以及食品中存在情况、生物活性、毒性和监管信息等注释。数据库还提供了专家从5592篇出版物中整理的1054种化合物的生物制造证据，通过结构化、可追溯记录关联微生物宿主、底物、遗传改造和定量生产指标。此外，数据库收录了971种化合物的2002条文献报道生物合成途径，可用于比较替代前体、酶组合和途径架构。对于尚无文献报道途径的化合物，SynBioFooDB提供计算预测的候选途径，以辅助途径优选和实验评估。通过整合化合物层面的背景、生物制造证据和生物合成途径信息，该库支持对食品相关化合物微生物生产策略的系统探索、比较与理性设计。

papers.abstract: Abstract Early detection of transplant rejection remains a major unmet clinical need because histopathology is invasive, episodic, and subject to sampling error, whereas serum creatinine and other routine chemistries often rise only after injury is established [1–4]. papers.title: High-throughput protein interactome identifies LSD1 as a regulator of SARS-CoV-2 production through lysine demethylation of viral nucleocapsid protein.
papers.abstract: High-throughput identification and imaging of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) under physiological conditions remains a significant challenge. Concurrently, the SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid (N) protein, the most abundant viral protein, plays an essential role in viral production. To advance the understanding of viral mechanisms and support antiviral development, we developed the brightest and smallest near-infrared bimolecular fluorescence complementation (NIR-BiFC) system using split miRFP670nano3. By integrating this system with next-generation sequencing (NGS), we established NIR-BiFC-Seq for the high-throughput mapping of protein interactomes. Applying this method, we systematically investigated interactions between the SARS-CoV-2 N protein and host cellular proteins. Our findings reveal that lysine-specific demethylase-1 (LSD1) demethylates the N protein at lysine 233 (K233), thereby enhancing viral production through the potentiation of multiple N protein functions. These include N protein dimerization, interaction with Nsp12, binding to viral RNA, and liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). Notably, inhibitors targeting the K233 site significantly suppressed SARS-CoV-2 production. This study establishes NIR-BiFC-Seq as a sensitive synthetic biology platform for interactome mapping and identifies LSD1-mediated regulatory mechanisms as promising targets for antiviral therapy.
papers.authors: Liu D, Yan C, Fu J, Liao Z, Zhang Y, Gan H, Zhou H, Zhang XE, Chen M.

enrichment.titleZh: 高通量蛋白质相互作用组分析揭示LSD1通过病毒核衣壳蛋白赖氨酸去甲基化调控SARS-CoV-2产生
enrichment.abstractZh: 在生理条件下，高通量鉴定蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）并对其成像，仍是一项重大挑战。同时，SARS-CoV-2核衣壳（N）蛋白是含量最高的病毒蛋白，在病毒产生中发挥关键作用。为增进对病毒机制的认识并支持抗病毒开发，研究者使用拆分的miRFP670nano3，开发了亮度最高且体积最小的近红外双分子荧光互补（NIR-BiFC）系统。通过将该系统与新一代测序（NGS）相整合，研究者建立了NIR-BiFC-Seq，用于高通量绘制蛋白质相互作用组。应用这一方法，研究者系统考察了SARS-CoV-2 N蛋白与宿主细胞蛋白之间的相互作用。结果揭示，赖氨酸特异性去甲基化酶1（LSD1）使N蛋白第233位赖氨酸（K233）去甲基化，从而通过增强N蛋白的多种功能促进病毒产生。这些功能包括N蛋白二聚化、与Nsp12相互作用、与病毒RNA结合，以及液-液相分离（LLPS）。值得注意的是，靶向K233位点的抑制剂显著抑制了SARS-CoV-2的产生。本研究建立了NIR-BiFC-Seq这一用于相互作用组绘制的灵敏合成生物学平台，并将LSD1介导的调控机制确定为有前景的抗病毒治疗靶点。

papers.title: Programmable Engineered Living Vehicles as Autonomous Biofactories for Synergistic Osteomyelitis Management and Bone Regeneration.
papers.abstract: Conventional static biomaterials and synthetic nanomedicines struggle to penetrate recalcitrant biofilms and orchestrate tissue regeneration in deep-seated infections due to limited autonomous navigation and a lack of spatiotemporal responsiveness. Here, we conceptualize and develop a programmable engineered living vehicle (ELV) that functions as an autonomous biofactory for the synergistic management of drug-resistant osteomyelitis. Built upon a self-propelled Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 chassis with innate ecological dominance, these living biofactories are hierarchically equipped with environmental biosensors and logic-gated computing modules. Crucially, leveraging AlphaFold 3-guided molecular docking, we engineered multiscale thermo-responsive genetic logic circuits that enable precise, temperature-dependent biomanufacturing of bacteriolytic lysostaphin (LYS) and vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP) (≥37°C), coupled with a fail-safe thermal self-destruct mechanism (≥42°C). Furthermore, surface-engineered (DSS) 6 peptides confer robust hydroxyapatite affinity, acting as a bone-homing navigation module. In a rat osteomyelitis model induced by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), intravenously deployed ELV biofactories autonomously navigate to the infected niche, actively penetrate biofilms, and outperform vancomycin in pathogen clearance. Concurrently, localized payload secretion reprograms the osteo-immune microenvironment, significantly accelerating bone repair. This work establishes a versatile paradigm for next-generation smart living therapeutics, bridging synthetic biology with micro-engineering to address complex clinical challenges.
papers.authors: Lan Y, Liu X, Shi Z, Li Y, Chi A, Zheng J, Ye T, Xiao C, Zheng R, Yang Y, Shi X, Zhu X, Chai M, Yan S.

enrichment.titleZh: 可编程工程活体载体：用于骨髓炎协同治疗与骨再生的自主生物工厂
enrichment.abstractZh: 传统静态生物材料和合成纳米药物缺少自主导航及对时空变化的响应能力，因而难以穿透顽固生物膜并在深部感染中协调组织再生。本研究提出并构建了可编程工程活体载体（ELV），作为自主生物工厂协同应对耐药性骨髓炎。该体系以具有自主运动能力和固有生态竞争优势的大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 为底盘，分层配置环境生物传感器和逻辑门计算模块。借助 AlphaFold 3 指导的分子对接，研究者设计了多尺度温度响应遗传逻辑电路，使其在温度≥37°C时按温度条件生产溶葡萄球菌酶（LYS）和血管活性肠肽（VIP），同时在温度≥42°C时触发热自毁保险机制。表面工程化的 (DSS)6 肽赋予载体较强的羟基磷灰石亲和力，发挥骨组织归巢导航作用。在耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）诱导的大鼠骨髓炎模型中，经静脉给药的 ELV 可自主到达感染部位、主动穿透生物膜，其病原菌清除效果优于万古霉素。局部释放的功能产物还可重塑骨免疫微环境，显著促进骨修复。作者认为，这项工作将合成生物学与微工程结合，为智能活体治疗提供了可拓展的设计范式。

papers.title: Small genomes, big lessons: What viruses teach us about structure-based riboregulation.
papers.abstract: RNA viruses encode multiple layers of information within a single molecule, which functions simultaneously as a template for protein synthesis and as a structured regulatory RNA. These structures control key aspects of viral gene expression, govern host interactions, and mediate immune evasion. Although the prevalence of RNA structure in viral genomes is now well established, only recently have functional and mechanistic studies begun to uncover how these elements act as regulatory modules that shape infection outcomes. With their compact genomes and experimentally tractable life cycles, RNA viruses represent powerful model systems for uncovering the fundamental building blocks of riboregulation and illuminating principles of gene control conserved across eukaryotes. Here, we review current mechanistic understanding of RNA structure-based regulation across diverse viral families and draw parallels to structure-mediated gene control in eukaryotic transcriptomes, highlighting RNA structure as a central regulatory layer in gene expression with broad therapeutic and synthetic biology potential.
papers.authors: Hann T, Jang H, Sung YC, Guh CL, Hiers NM, Tsao LH, Luo M, Pyle AM.

enrichment.titleZh: 小基因组，大启示：病毒如何帮助我们认识基于结构的RNA调控
enrichment.abstractZh: RNA病毒在同一分子中编码多层信息，该分子既是蛋白质合成的模板，也作为具有特定结构的调控性RNA发挥作用。这些结构控制病毒基因表达的关键环节，调节与宿主的相互作用，并介导免疫逃逸。尽管RNA结构在病毒基因组中的普遍存在已得到充分认识，但直到最近，功能与机制研究才开始揭示这些元件如何作为调控模块影响感染结局。RNA病毒具有紧凑的基因组和便于开展实验研究的生命周期，因此成为有力的模式系统，可用于揭示RNA调控的基本构成要素，以及真核生物中保守的基因控制原则。本文综述了目前对不同病毒科中基于RNA结构的调控机制的认识，并将其与真核生物转录组中由结构介导的基因控制进行对照，强调RNA结构是基因表达的一个核心调控层面，在治疗与合成生物学方面具有广泛潜力。

papers.title: From cell factories to photobiocatalysts: reengineering cyanobacteria for solar-driven chemical manufacturing.
papers.abstract: To achieve more sustainable, light-powered chemical manufacturing, cyanobacterial engineering is expanding from conventional carbon-accumulating "cell factories" toward the complementary use of cyanobacteria as "whole-cell photobiocatalysts." This review critically examines this conceptual extension. By shifting the engineering focus from carbon-centric biosynthesis to electron- and energy-coupled catalysis, this emerging approach partially decouples target-product formation from the de novo assembly of CO 2 -derived carbon skeletons. Instead, it exploits photosynthetically generated reducing equivalents and ATP to support redox and energy-dependent enzymatic transformations, thereby reducing dependence on external cofactor- or energy-regeneration systems. We outline a multidimensional engineering framework that integrates carbon-flux redirection ("push"), coupling to photosynthetically generated reducing equivalents and ATP ("drive"), and product-removal-driven "pull" through secretion, volatilization, or in situ extraction. We further highlight advances in light-tolerant and stress-robust cyanobacterial chassis, together with emerging process strategies based on attached-growth and biofilm photobioreactors. We also critically consider genetic instability, variable enzyme-coupling efficiency, and scale-dependent light and mass-transfer limitations. Finally, we discuss the biophysical and energetic limits of light-to-chemical conversion, competition for reducing power, the largely conceptual potential of temporally decoupled light harvesting and dark-phase catalysis, and the need to select economically viable target products using rigorous techno-economic and life-cycle analyses. Collectively, this review provides conceptual and practical guidance for developing sustainable photosynthetic biomanufacturing platforms.
papers.authors: Pan K, Liu D, Chen L, Sun T, Zhang W.

enrichment.titleZh: 从细胞工厂到光生物催化剂：重构蓝细菌以实现太阳能驱动的化学品制造
enrichment.abstractZh: 为实现更可持续的光驱动化学品制造，蓝细菌工程正从传统的碳积累型“细胞工厂”拓展至互补的“全细胞光生物催化剂”应用。本综述对这一概念拓展进行了批判性分析。通过将工程重点从以碳为中心的生物合成转向电子和能量耦合的催化，这种新方式可在一定程度上将目标产物形成与 CO₂ 来源碳骨架的从头组装解耦，而利用光合作用产生的还原当量和 ATP，支持依赖氧化还原反应或能量的酶促转化，减少对外源辅因子或能量再生体系的依赖。文章提出多维工程框架，将碳通量重定向的“推力”、光合还原当量与 ATP 耦合的“驱动力”，以及通过分泌、挥发或原位提取移除产物形成的“拉力”相结合。综述还介绍了耐光、抗胁迫蓝细菌底盘，以及附着生长和生物膜光生物反应器等工艺策略，并分析遗传不稳定、酶耦合效率变化，以及规模放大时的光照和传质限制。最后，文章讨论光到化学能转化的生物物理及能量极限、还原力竞争、在时间上分离光捕获与暗期催化这一主要仍处于概念阶段的潜力，以及通过严格技术经济和生命周期分析选择经济可行产品的必要性，为可持续光合生物制造提供概念和实践指导。

papers.title: Sustainable biomanufacturing of rare ginsenosides from Panax notoginseng : a critical review.
papers.abstract: Rare ginsenosides (e.g. C-K, Rg3, Rh2) hold therapeutic promise but are severely constrained by low natural abundance. This review critically examines the entire biomanufacturing pipeline from green extraction to multi-modal conversion and de novo biosynthesis. Unlike previous reviews focusing on single technologies, this work systematically evaluates physical, chemical, and biological strategies and proposes an integrated upstream-midstream-downstream framework. Physical and chemical conversion methods can produce rare ginsenosides from abundant common precursors in Panax notoginseng , yet suffer from harsh conditions, poor selectivity, and C-20 epimeric mixtures. Biotransformation offers high regioselectivity, mild conditions, and retention of the desired 20(S)-configuration. However, distinct challenges exist such as microbial whole-cell fermentation suffers from complex metabolic networks, long cycles, and difficult separation, while enzymatic catalysis faces high enzyme costs, poor stability, and single-step limitations. Notably, while de novo biosynthesis draws upon key enzyme genes from Panax notoginseng to theoretically eliminate plant dependence, facing metabolic burden, low titers, and high costs, remain far from industrial viability. We highlight biocatalytic strengths including enzyme-mediated precise deglycosylation and recent breakthroughs in directed enzyme engineering for single products. From a techno-economic perspective, enzymatic conversion remains the most competitive route for producing rare ginsenosides at present, whereas de novo biosynthesis currently lacks the efficiency and economic feasibility to replace it.
papers.authors: Liang D, Tian H, Zhao H, Bu R, Huang W, Li X, Gao W.

enrichment.titleZh: 三七稀有人参皂苷的可持续生物制造：批判性综述
enrichment.abstractZh: 稀有人参皂苷（如 C-K、Rg3 和 Rh2）具有治疗开发潜力，但其天然含量低，限制了供应。本综述系统评估从绿色提取、多模式转化到从头生物合成的完整制造流程，并提出整合上游、中游和下游的框架。物理和化学转化可利用三七中丰富的常见前体制备稀有人参皂苷，但存在条件苛刻、选择性差及产生 C-20 差向异构体混合物等问题。生物转化具有区域选择性高、条件温和以及保留目标 20(S) 构型的优势，但微生物全细胞发酵面临代谢网络复杂、周期长和分离困难等挑战，酶催化则受酶成本高、稳定性差和单步反应限制。利用三七关键酶基因的从头生物合成理论上可消除对植物原料的依赖，但仍受代谢负担、产量低和成本高等因素制约，距离工业可行性较远。文章强调酶介导精准脱糖基化及定向酶工程在单一产物制备中的进展。从技术经济角度看，作者认为酶法转化目前仍是生产稀有人参皂苷最具竞争力的路线，而从头生物合成尚不具备替代它的效率和经济可行性。

papers.title: The historical evolution of CHO cell line development for biologics production: 60 years and still counting.
papers.abstract: Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells have played a central role in the production of therapeutic proteins since their initial isolation in the 1950s. Over the decades, scientific innovations have transformed CHO cells into the powerhouse of the biopharmaceutical industry. From rudimentary culture conditions and random integration of transgenes into the host genome, to synthetic biology, genetic engineering, high-performing chemically defined media, targeted transgene integration and AI-driven cell line development strategies, each decade has introduced transformative tools, knowledge, and insights to improve CHO cell line development and characterization processes. This review outlines the chronological history of the CHO cell line development process, decade by decade, highlighting central milestones and innovations, technological breakthroughs, and the role of key innovative steps that have enabled modern cell line development workflows and ultimately the industrial-scale manufacturing of biologics.
papers.authors: Fieder J, Schneider S, Fischer S.

enrichment.titleZh: 生物制品生产用 CHO 细胞系开发的历史演进：六十年历程仍在继续
enrichment.abstractZh: 自20世纪50年代首次分离以来，中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞一直在治疗性蛋白生产中发挥核心作用。数十年来，科学创新使 CHO 细胞成为生物制药工业的主要生产平台。从简陋的培养条件和外源基因在宿主基因组中的随机整合，到合成生物学、基因工程、高性能化学成分限定培养基、外源基因定点整合，以及人工智能驱动的细胞系开发策略，每个年代都带来了改变 CHO 细胞系开发与表征流程的工具、知识和认识。本综述按年代梳理 CHO 细胞系开发的历史，突出关键里程碑、创新和技术突破，以及推动现代细胞系开发流程并最终实现生物制品工业规模制造的重要步骤。

papers.title: Transglycosidases from Aspergillus genus and their applications in food processing: Advances in enzyme mining and smart biocatalysis.
papers.abstract: Transglycosidases (TGs) constitute a family of glycoside hydrolases that perform glycosyl transfer via intra- and intermolecular substitution. A. niger, A. oryzae, and other Aspergillus strains represent the major industrial sources of TGs, which are widely applied in food processing. However, prominent bottlenecks still restrict the optimization of enzyme performance, industrial adaptation, and the construction of synergistic catalytic systems. This comprehensive review expounds the application potential of Aspergillus-derived TGs in food processing, analyzes the scientific basis of artificial intelligence (AI) regulation on enzyme catalytic performance, systematically summarizes the molecular modification and multi-enzyme synergistic mechanisms, and illustrates their application effects in the fields of prebiotic oligosaccharides, dairy products, brewing, and baking. Furthermore, it promotes the in-depth integration of AI and food biomanufacturing, and advances the high-quality development of the green functional food processing industry, showing sustainable and bright prospects in smart bioprocessing and big-health food research.
papers.authors: Zhu W, Tang J, Song X, Jia X, Deng W, Chen X, Tang M, Liu X, Shi H, Zhou J, Tan Z.

enrichment.titleZh: 曲霉属来源的转糖苷酶及其在食品加工中的应用：酶挖掘与智能生物催化研究进展
enrichment.abstractZh: 转糖苷酶（TGs）属于糖苷水解酶家族，可通过分子内或分子间取代完成糖基转移。黑曲霉、米曲霉及其他曲霉菌株是工业转糖苷酶的主要来源，这类酶广泛应用于食品加工。不过，酶性能优化、工业适应及协同催化体系构建仍受到明显瓶颈制约。本综述阐述曲霉来源转糖苷酶在食品加工中的应用潜力，分析利用人工智能调控酶催化性能的科学依据，系统总结分子改造和多酶协同机制，并介绍其在益生元低聚糖、乳制品、酿造和烘焙等领域的应用效果。文章进一步讨论人工智能与食品生物制造的融合，以及绿色功能食品加工、智能生物加工和大健康食品研究的发展前景。
